board: ESP32-CAM AI Thinker / ESP32 clássico, câmera e PSRAM ativas
converted_board: PCF8575 no footprint do CD74HC4067, pino 1 alinhado
capacitor: 100nF between converted board VCC/GND, close to IC; keep existing if suitable

battery.access: GPIO33 is not on the standard header. Remove/isolate the red status LED branch and identify the GPIO33-side pad by continuity; do not use the 3V3-side pad or GPIO4 white flash LED.
battery.firmware: Input analog, internal pulls disabled; calibrated ADC at 12 dB (legacy 11 dB), settle 200 ms, spaced multisampling; battery voltage = 2 * calibrated ADC voltage. Never drive GPIO33 as LED output.
battery.power: Measure raw battery before the boost/regulator. Keep battery negative and ESP GND common. This divider is not the battery power or charging circuit.

firmware_status: Proposed wiring; integrated keyboard/LCD/battery firmware not yet implemented or bench-tested
firmware_constraints: Use a separate ESP32 I2C controller from camera SCCB; preserve camera bus configuration.
Maintain a shared 16-bit PCF output shadow; LCD writes and keypad scanning must preserve each other.
PCF quasi-bidirectional column inputs must stay written high.
keypad_contact_order: Logical L1-L4/COL1-COL5; physical ribbon order must be identified
